headings.fontFamily: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Space Grotesk (sans-serif)
headings.instruction: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Lato for headings. Use an industrial, wide, high-impact font like Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit.

body.fontFamily: Satoshi, DM Sans, or IBM Plex Sans
body.instruction: Clean, highly readable font for forms, body text, and dashboard data.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

hero.style: Kinetic, large typography, masked line-by-line reveal.
hero.background: Dark overlay (bg-black/50) over an industrial background image or subtle noise.
hero.structure: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, text spans 8 cols.

bento_grid.instruction: For 'Servizi' and 'Come funziona', use Tetris Bento grid logic. Never fill 100% symmetrically.

dashboard_grid.instruction: High Density Grid for the admin panel. Strict grid hierarchy, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use Shadcn tables for submissions.
dashboard_grid.style: Flat cards, 1px borders, dense data presentation.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Wrap the app in a Lenis provider.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer motion line-by-line reveal. Split text into lines, overflow-hidden, y: '100%' to y: 0 with stagger.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer motion whileInView={ y: 0, opacity: 1 }, initial={ y: 40, opacity: 0 }, viewport={ once: true, margin: '-100px' }
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an endless scrolling ribbon of 'Aree Coperte'. Style: huge outline text or small editorial ribbon.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: subtle scale up (scale: 1.02), border changes from white/10 to white/30.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle SVG noise/grain fixed overlay to the entire body (pointer-events-none, opacity-20) to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-white/10) on cards. Sharp corners or extremely subtle rounding (rounded-none or rounded-sm max).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky header and admin dashboard sidebar. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.

forms.style: Shadcn UI base but stripped of the Vercel look. Inputs must have bg-transparent, border-b border-white/20 ONLY (no full borders), rounded-none, text-white, focus:border-[#FF5A00] focus:ring-0. Architectural, brutalist feel.
forms.labels: text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-white/60 mb-2 block

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#E04F00] transition-colors relative overflow-hidden group
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:border-white transition-colors

cards.style: Flat, sharp edges, bg-[#111] border border-white/10. Inner padding p-8. Used for Servizi and Come Funziona.

accordion.style: For FAQ. Shadcn Accordion. border-b border-white/10. Large text for triggers (text-xl sm:text-2xl font-light).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A0A0A meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use white/70 for body text to reduce eye strain, but keep headings pure white.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring (ring-[#FF5A00]).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.images: Use high-contrast, moody industrial shots. Limit opacity with bg-black/50 to ensure text readability.
media.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a sharp, technical look.

3d_libraries.parallax: Use Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform for a subtle parallax on the Hero background image. Do not overcomplicate with WebGL unless strictly needed for the '3D moment'. A highly polished parallax with Framer Motion fits the Awwwards brief best.

hero.description: Welding sparks night - Use with heavy bg-black/50 overlay as the hero background to set a high-end, dramatic, industrial tone.

services_electrical.description: Technician working on circuit breaker. Use in the 'Elettricista' service card or 'Come lavoriamo'.

partner_section.description: Blueprint with pencil. Use for the 'Diventa Partner' call to action background or beside the form.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building Centrale Operativa Artigiani (COA), an Awwwards-level landing page.
MUST use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to achieve overlapping and asymmetry. DO NOT use Shadcn 'Card' wrapper for main layout grids, build them manually.
MUST use Shadcn UI strictly for logic-heavy components: Forms, Inputs, Select, Accordion (FAQ), and the Admin Dashboard data tables.
Inject a global noise texture overlay to break digital flatness.
DO NOT center-align paragraphs. Use left-alignment with generous max-widths for readability.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout wrapper.
Implement Framer Motion for the Hero text reveal (kinetic, masked lines) and scroll reveals (fade up).
Include a Marquee (using react-fast-marquee) for the 'Aree Coperte' section.
For the 9 'Servizi' cards, use an asymmetric CSS Grid (e.g., md:grid-cols-3 with some items spanning 2 rows or 2 columns) rather than a uniform 3x3 grid.
Forms must have photo/file upload fields as requested. Style inputs aggressively minimal (border bottom only, no background, uppercase labels).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp architectural buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
